additional_info.subject: Ticket can be closed.
additional_info.body:
Issues were resolved with help of one colleague from R&D (Patrick Rohnstock) and colleagues from backend provider, CCV and VR payment. On-site visit of Lukas Berger also took place.
Major misunderstanding existed between CCV, VR payment and potentially our factory whether or not CCV terminals were delivered with incorrect software.
Even CCV hotline provided me with incorrect info that software version cannot be used / updated.
Please investigate with CCV how this can be avoided.
